decisions.reason: The existing same-message Small Block MODIFY already records that mints and secondary sales count toward its draw and that mint sales fund its pool. The approximate sales cadence does not necessarily invalidate the existing pool target.
The same-message FAQ INTRODUCE already states the Big Block sales cadence, counted sale types, and ongoing pool funding.
Changing which sales count toward Big Block draws and fund its pool does not alter ticket issuance for successful referral-code mints.
The same-message INTRODUCE already records that primary-sale revenue is allocated to both active prize pools; the source adds no further price or allocation change.
Sales counting and pool funding do not change the Chainlink VRF winner-selection method or its applicable draws.
The source modification concerns Big Block draw accounting and pool funding, not allocation of tickets when a mint has no referral code.
The separate Small and Big Block ticket counters and their post-draw resets remain valid regardless of which sales fund or count toward a draw.
Using secondary-sale proceeds to fund the prize pool does not change whether the flat $10 secondary royalty is enabled or enforced.
Big Block sales accounting and pool funding do not alter the Winners-page one-click prize claim flow.
The source modification does not change which ticket counters, badges, or referral-code attributes appear in NFT metadata.
The Big Block accounting change does not alter the Winners page as the winner-announcement channel.
The Big Block prize-pool accounting decision is independent of the Transak provider, conversion flow, and supported fiat payment methods.
